tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: This lab provides an overview of submitting and creating workshops and labs for Oracle LiveLabs and other platforms.

tutorials.title: LiveLabs SLAs
tutorials.description: This document outlines the Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for the Oracle LiveLabs platform, including response times for PRs, approvals, publishing, and support.

tutorials.title: Need more information on GitHub?
tutorials.description: Describes what GitHub is and general information on projects and repositories

tutorials.title: Need to understand the status workflow in WMS?
tutorials.description: Details the status in WMS and what comes next, who is responsible.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Submit new workshop in WMS
tutorials.description: This lab walks you through working with Oracle Workshop Management System (WMS) and shows you the workflow for developing a workshop.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Set up GitHub and install tools
tutorials.description: This lab helps you configure your environment for developing labs and workshops using Markdown and GitHub.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Stay in sync with GitHub environment
tutorials.description: This lab shows you the Oracle LiveLabs GitHub folder structure how to fork and clone the repositories. Also use the common labs and images with the workshop templates.

tutorials.title: Lab 4a: Capture effective screens - Best practices
tutorials.description: This lab will describe the best practices when capturing screens.

tutorials.title: Lab 4b: How to use OptiShot to optimize screenshots
Lab 5a: Develop Markdown and content
tutorials.description: This lab gives you tips and tricks for editing and developing your lab (markdown) content using LiveLabs standards and accessibility for your workshops.

tutorials.title: Lab 5b: Embed SQL Developer using freesql.com
tutorials.description: This lab shows you how to embed SQL Developer in a LiveLabs workshop using FreeSQL.

tutorials.title: Lab 5c: Add LiveLabs Quizzes to your workshops
Lab 5d: Fixomat 2000
tutorials.description: This lab shows you how to use Fixomat for LiveLabs markdown repair and cleanup.

tutorials.title: Lab 6a: Quality Assurance checks and steps
tutorials.description: This lab prepares you for Quality Assurance of your workshop, details to look for and adjust before publishing your workshop.

tutorials.title: Lab 6b: Pull Request Automated Checks
Lab 7: Publish your workshop
tutorials.description: This lab walks you through the WMS steps to publish your workshop.

tutorials.title: Lab 8a: Publish to Live SQL
tutorials.description: This lab shows you how to create a tutorial in Live SQL

tutorials.title: Lab 8b: Live SQL Integration
tutorials.description: This lab shows you how to integrate Live SQL in your workshop

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Develop LiveLabs Sprints
tutorials.description: This lab shows you how to create a Sprint for LiveLabs

tutorials.title: Lab 10a: Setup Graphical Remote Desktop
tutorials.description: This lab will describe how to create and use a graphical remote desktop for your workshop.

tutorials.title: Lab 10b: Create Custom Image for Marketplace
tutorials.description: This lab will describe how to create and use a marketplace image for your workshop.

tutorials.title: Lab 10c: Publish Your Image to Oracle Marketplace
tutorials.description: This lab will show you how to publish your image to Oracle Marketplace.

tutorials.title: Lab 10d: Update the Image on Your Sandbox Environment
tutorials.description: This lab will show you how to get your new Marketplace image added to your LiveLab.

tutorials.title: Lab 11a: Secure Desktop Environments in LiveLabs
tutorials.description: This lab will show you how to get your new Marketplace image added to your LiveLab.

tutorials.title: Lab 11b: How to Request and Access Secure Desktop Environments
tutorials.description: This lab will show you how to get your new Marketplace image added to your LiveLab.

tutorials.title: Lab 12: Get Started with the LiveLabs AI Developer Hub
tutorials.description: This lab points authors to the LiveLabs AI Developer Hub for deeper workflow guides instead of repeating that content here.

tutorials.title: Lab 13: Create a LiveStack
tutorials.description: This lab shows you how to create a LiveStack in WMS.

tutorials.title: Lab 14: Create and Manage Assets
tutorials.description: This lab shows you how to create and manage assets using the WMS Self-Service Portal.
